cohort: 500 consecutive, consenting pregnant women from December 2017 to November 2019 at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical sciences, Sewagram, Wardha, M.S, Maharashtra, India
finding: The prevalence of low birth weight babies was 32.4%, and rural residence, low socioeconomic status, and lower maternal education were significantly associated with low birth weight.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW) and normal birth weight (NBW)
